unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #21 "Add Nano (XNO) as a third settlement path — self-custodial, no card/account/KYC" on worldliberty/agentpay-sdk. Argued in its own design terms: the self-custodial local-wallet daemon already keeps full wallet control, and Nano is a self-generated keypair with no registry/KYC — the same policy and approval path wraps a Nano send, the confirmed block is the immutable receipt; carried live Vend nano-info endpoint. https://github.com/worldliberty/agentpay-sdk/issues/21
